fact_text: Foodpanda entered Pakistan in 2014 by acquiring a local food-delivery company, which the CEO called the first technology acquisition exit in Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Foodpanda was launched under Rocket Internet, then acquired by German firm Delivery Hero around 2016, and Delivery Hero listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in 2017.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Delivery Hero operates in about 75 countries under several food-delivery brands, and the CEO called it the largest food-delivery company outside China.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: The group owns about seven food-delivery brands worldwide, with Foodpanda as its Asian platform and other brands in Turkey, the Middle East, Europe and Korea.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Foodpanda operates in 11 Asian markets, with Pakistan as its westernmost market, and no Indian market is included in the footprint.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Foodpanda serves 35 cities in Pakistan, including tier-3 towns such as Mardan, Larkana and Mandi Bahauddin, which the CEO said were chosen where demand was seen.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Groceries and other non-food delivery made up about 25% of Foodpanda's total revenue in Pakistan as of the interview, up from 10-12% around 2023, according to the CEO.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Foodpanda's grocery arm PandaMart operates in six Pakistani cities, with pharmacy delivery in four to five cities, and third-party retail partners are being scaled gradually.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Restaurants are sorted into tiers A to D, and the platform onboards down to tier D after a physical sales visit that checks kitchen separation, bathroom separation and the menu.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Foodpanda requires a restaurant's delivery-app prices to match its own dine-in and direct channel prices, and the CEO said the platform cannot verify this online because most menus are not published digitally.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Foodpanda caps its commission at 30% for restaurants and at 28% for home chefs, in line with global delivery-app practice where caps range from about 30% to 35%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: The CEO said the average commission is well below the cap, because commission rates depend on the revenue each order generates for the restaurant, which offsets the platform's cost.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: The CEO rejected social-media claims that Foodpanda charges restaurants around 40% commission, calling them completely untrue.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Last-mile point-to-point delivery is the most expensive and least predictable cost in logistics, and delivery platforms recover it through commission rates.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Foodpanda's average food delivery time is about 28 minutes, because food is more time-sensitive for heat and freshness than groceries.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Foodpanda's average grocery delivery takes about 35 minutes, and the CEO said road quality in some Pakistani areas makes delivery times harder to keep predictable.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Customers who order both food and groceries on Foodpanda order about six times more often than food-only customers, according to the CEO.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: The CEO said the habit of ordering household groceries online is not yet established in Pakistan as food delivery is, though grocery delivery began during the 2020 COVID period and is growing fast.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: The CEO cited South Korea, which has the highest e-commerce orders per capita, as a benchmark with online penetration of about 85-90%, the level Foodpanda aims to reach.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Foodpanda riders are freelancers who register at hubs or online, and they must pass physical verification with licence and bike details shared with NIC and law enforcement before onboarding.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: The CEO said a freelance rider working about 48 hours a week earns roughly 35% above minimum wage, plus tips paid directly, while a normal full-time job runs about 8-10 hours over six days.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Foodpanda estimates that cash tips cover riders' fuel costs, though the platform has no visibility into cash-paid tips.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Foodpanda had about 5,000 home chefs cooking from home across Pakistan, roughly 75% of them women, and the CEO said 50-60% of those women were first-time earners.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Foodpanda's home-chef programme operated in about 20-22 of its 35 Pakistani cities as of the interview, and the platform is expanding it gradually.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Foodpanda advises home chefs to list 15-18 menu items, because too few items reduce conversion and a generic cuisine menu attracts the most customers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Foodpanda forecasts order volume for a vendor from area data, with an example of about 10 orders a day for a similar vendor in a busy area, plus or minus 10-20%, and shares weekly sales data with vendors.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: The CEO said late orders are Foodpanda's largest complaint category, followed by spilled orders and food quality issues that usually trace back to poor packaging.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Payment-related complaints made up less than 1% of Foodpanda's total complaints, according to the CEO, who said the ideal figure would be zero.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Foodpanda credits refunds to an in-app wallet at once, while card refunds can take three to 21 working days and banks do not notify customers when the reversal posts.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Foodpanda moved purchase orders to its grocery distributors from emailed files to an automated system, and the CEO said fill rates from those distributors have improved, so an order of 10 cartons arrives in full.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: The CEO said Foodpanda ranks first in about 85% of the markets it operates in and exits any market where it falls below second place.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: The CEO named Grab as a larger rival in Southeast Asia, present in five countries there, and said Foodpanda treats restaurants' own delivery channels as partners rather than competitors.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: The CEO said the economy was unstable from about 2022 to mid-2024 for political and economic reasons, which hit household spending and delivery demand, and stability improved in the months before the interview.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: Fuel costs fluctuated sharply in Pakistan in 2022-2024 through inflation and forex pressure, and supply-chain costs were erratic, which hit restaurants and delivery platforms alike.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: The CEO said mobile operators spend in dollars but earn in rupees, and patchy coverage in some areas creates connectivity gaps that affect delivery apps.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)

fact_text: A Pakistani business school study on Foodpanda's contribution to GDP was to be released in May 2025, and the CEO said its extrapolated figures were humbling.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'All The Questions You Have About Foodpanda Answered | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-04-30)
